body.content: False-green risk: For the lease-mismatch, a mutation that performs a homogeneous identity comparison ignoring drift fields would pass silently. For the seat-binding, a mutation that homogenizes the identity check between the school and seat would also pass silently. The forbidden cases must explicitly target these mutations.
